The ground truth answer states that the film editor for the Grand Prix winner of the 2003 Bratislava International Film Festival was born in "Roudnice nad Labem." The predicted answer claims the editor was Jiří Brožek and that he was born in "Prague, Czech Republic." These are different birthplaces. Even if Jiří Brožek was indeed the editor, the predicted answer does not mention "Roudnice nad Labem" (the ground truth), nor is "Prague" equivalent. Therefore, the substance of the ground truth answer is not present in the predicted answer.
